architecture.pattern: Clean Architecture / MVVM with Offline-First Repository & MediaSessionService
layers: Data (NewPipeExtractor Client, InnerTube API Client, Room DB, EncryptedSharedPreferences, Media3 DownloadManager, Repositories)
Playback Engine (AndroidX MediaSessionService, ExoPlayer 1.4.1, AudioOnly Player Adapter)
Presentation (Jetpack Compose UI, Material 3, Accessibility Semantics, ViewModels)
architecture.a11y_strategy: Strict Screen Reader Optimization (TalkBack and Jieshuo/CSR): explicit contentDescription without emoji noise, liveRegion for async search/sync/playback feedback, custom accessibility actions for list items, minimum 48dp touch targets, semantic state announcements, trap-free WebView dialogs.
architecture.persistence: AndroidX Room (SQLite) for Subscriptions, Playback Resume State, Download Records; EncryptedSharedPreferences for Auth Cookies and Session Tokens; SimpleCache for Audio Chunks

requirements.title: Pure Audio Only Stream Extraction & Playback
requirements.description: Zero video rendering engine. Stream audio directly using NewPipeExtractor to retrieve audio-only formats (m4a/opus/webm) and play via Media3 ExoPlayer with lockscreen MediaSession controls and background playback support.
requirements.verification_criteria: ExoPlayer plays audio stream with screen off / in background without decoding video buffers; notification controls respond to play/pause/seek.

requirements.title: Offline Audio Downloading & Cache Management
requirements.description: Full offline download support prioritizing audio streams. Downloads managed via Media3 DownloadManager/Downloader with metadata tracked in Room DB. Support pausing, resuming, deleting, and offline playback without network access.
requirements.verification_criteria: Audio file downloaded completely to cache/storage, appears in offline downloads list, and plays without internet connection.

requirements.title: Resume Playback Position Tracking
requirements.description: Persist user playback progress in Room database periodically and on pause/stop. Upon opening an audio item, prompt or automatically resume from last saved timestamp unless completed (>95%).
requirements.verification_criteria: Stopping audio at 05:23 and reopening resumes at 05:23; completed tracks reset position.

requirements.title: Local Channel Subscriptions & Feed Ingestion
requirements.description: Maintain 100% on-device local channel subscriptions in Room database. Allow user to subscribe/unsubscribe without Google account login. Aggregate latest feed items from subscribed channels via NewPipeExtractor.
requirements.verification_criteria: User can subscribe to channels locally; feed tab displays chronologically sorted audio uploads from subscribed channels.

requirements.title: Search with Instant Accessibility Readout
requirements.description: Fast audio search with immediate accessibility announcement of results count, query state, and loading progress using aria-live / liveRegion semantics.
requirements.verification_criteria: Search queries execute swiftly; screen reader immediately announces result count and states clearly.

requirements.title: Complete Screen Reader Accessibility Compliance
requirements.description: Fully tailored for TalkBack and Jieshuo (CSR) screen readers: clear concise contentDescription labels without emoji noise, semantic action labels (e.g., Download, Subscribe, Resume), linear traversal order, and high contrast.
requirements.verification_criteria: App is 100% operable with screen reader gestures, zero unlabeled buttons, unambiguous announcements for all state transitions.

requirements.title: Google / YouTube Authentication & Encrypted Credential Management
requirements.description: Secure sign-in via Android WebView bypassing error 403 using Chrome Mobile User-Agent. Extract session cookies (SAPISID, HSID, SSID, SID, LOGIN_INFO) upon authentication completion and persist them securely using AndroidX EncryptedSharedPreferences.
requirements.verification_criteria: User signs in successfully; session cookies and SAPISID are extracted and persisted in EncryptedSharedPreferences; subsequent app launches preserve login status.

requirements.title: InnerTube API Subscriptions Synchronization via SAPISIDHASH
requirements.description: Authenticate YouTube InnerTube requests using dynamic SAPISIDHASH signature over /youtubei/v1/browse with browseId FEchannels. Ingest full channel subscriptions list with pagination handling and upsert into Room Subscriptions table.
requirements.verification_criteria: API returns HTTP 200 with subscriptions payload; all subscribed channels are ingested into Room database with channelId, title, and avatarUrl.

requirements.title: Offline Google Takeout CSV Import & Export
requirements.description: Allow account-free subscription synchronization by importing subscriptions.csv exported from Google Takeout. Support selecting file via Storage Access Framework, parsing channel IDs/titles, and batch inserting into Room. Also support exporting local subscriptions to CSV.
requirements.verification_criteria: Selecting subscriptions.csv parses all rows correctly, handles commas and quotes, and populates Room database without errors or network calls.

requirements.title: Accessible Account & Subscriptions Sync Interface
requirements.description: Dedicated Compose screen and dialogs for account status, one-tap sync, CSV import/export, and logout. Strictly compliant with TalkBack and Jieshuo screen readers: explicit non-emoji contentDescription, polite liveRegion announcements for sync progress, and minimum 48dp touch targets.
requirements.verification_criteria: TalkBack and Jieshuo navigate effortlessly through login, sync, and CSV import flows with zero unlabeled elements and clear progress readouts.

requirements.title: Channel Details & Uploads Screen
requirements.description: Clicking any subscribed channel in Subscriptions tab opens its dedicated screen displaying channel title, avatar, and its latest video/audio uploads via NewPipeExtractorHelper.getChannelFeed, with immediate play and download actions.
requirements.verification_criteria: Clicking a channel opens its uploads list; audio can be played or downloaded directly; accessible back navigation returns to subscriptions list.

requirements.title: Home Subscriptions Feed & Top Bar Search
requirements.description: A rich landing Home screen displaying latest audio uploads from subscribed channels with quick filter chips. The top app bar features an accessible search action button opening search on demand instead of an empty screen.
requirements.verification_criteria: Landing tab displays aggregated subscription feed; top search icon opens search smoothly; zero emoji noise and complete TalkBack / Jieshuo accessibility.

requirements.title: Clean Long-Click Video Action Menu & Custom Accessibility Actions
requirements.description: Eliminate cramped crowded icon buttons from video list items. Tapping an item plays audio directly. Long-pressing displays an accessible action sheet (Play, Download, View Channel), paired with native Compose custom accessibility actions for seamless TalkBack and Jieshuo navigation.
requirements.verification_criteria: List items are uncluttered; double-tap plays immediately; long-click presents accessible actions modal; zero emoji noise.

requirements.title: Multi-Quality Video and Audio Download
requirements.description: Provide download choices for high-quality audio (M4A) and video streams (MP4 360p/720p) extracted via NewPipeExtractor, with seamless progress tracking.
requirements.verification_criteria: User can select video or audio download; MP4 or M4A downloads successfully with accurate progress.

requirements.title: Public Storage Permissions & Dedicated SoundTube Directory
requirements.description: Store all downloads in a user-accessible public directory (/sdcard/Download/SoundTube/). Request runtime storage and notification permissions on app launch with accessible prompts.
requirements.verification_criteria: Downloads appear in /sdcard/Download/SoundTube/; runtime permissions requested on Android; files accessible by external players.

requirements.title: Chronological Video Feed Sorting (Latest First)
requirements.description: Sort video feed items chronologically in HomeScreen and ChannelDetailsScreen so that newest uploads appear first. Extract and format textualUploadDate/uploadDate for accessible readout on video cards.
requirements.verification_criteria: HomeScreen and ChannelDetailsScreen display recent uploads at the top with clear textual date labels (e.g. 'منذ ساعتين'); zero inverted chronological ordering.

requirements.title: Subscriptions Alphabetical Ordering & Instant Search Filter
requirements.description: Default subscriptions list ordering to alphabetical (A-Z / أ-ي) in Room SubscriptionDao. Provide sort toggle (Alphabetical vs Newest Subscribed) and an accessible instant search field for fast channel filtering.
requirements.verification_criteria: Subscriptions tab lists channels alphabetically by default; search field filters channels smoothly with instant TalkBack/Jieshuo feedback.

requirements.title: In-App OTA Auto-Update System
requirements.description: Integrated AppUpdateManager checking remote version.json and GitHub releases. Download updates with progress announcements, verify APK integrity/package name, and trigger system package installer seamlessly using FileProvider and REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES.
requirements.verification_criteria: App checks for updates on startup and on demand; downloads signed APK and triggers in-place system installer over existing version without uninstalling.

requirements.title: Automated GitHub Releases Publishing
requirements.description: Configure GitHub Actions workflow to publish verified signed APK as a GitHub Release (tag 'latest' and version tag) upon push to main, maintaining permanent keystore signature.
requirements.verification_criteria: GitHub Actions automatically generates release with signed APK; version.json matches release tag.

requirements.title: Feed Caching & Instant 0ms Startup
requirements.description: Persist home feed items in Room database (feed_cache). On app launch, display cached feed instantly with zero network delay, while triggering a quiet background refresh without UI blocking.
requirements.verification_criteria: App launch displays cached videos in <500ms; zero UI freezes or network starvation.

requirements.title: Arabic Localization & Multi-Track Dubbing Priority
requirements.description: Configure NewPipe with Arabic localization (ar-EG) and explicit Accept-Language header. In audio stream selection, prefer Arabic and Original audio tracks over English or secondary dubs.
requirements.verification_criteria: Video titles and audio tracks default to Arabic / Original audio; zero unexpected English dubbing on Arabic/original media.

requirements.title: Reliable Playback Resumption
requirements.description: Restore saved playback timestamp directly via controller.setMediaItem(mediaItem, startPositionMs) before playback preparation, with clear TalkBack / Jieshuo speech confirmation of the resumed minute/second.
requirements.verification_criteria: Closing and reopening a video resumes playback seamlessly from exact timestamp; screen reader announces resumption point.

requirements.title: Channel Tabs (Videos & Playlists) with Accessible Pagination
requirements.description: Organize channel details into standard YouTube tabs (Videos, Playlists) with accessible TabRow and an explicit 'Load More' button for progressive loading of the full channel catalog.
requirements.verification_criteria: Channel screen shows Videos and Playlists tabs; clicking Load More loads subsequent pages smoothly.

requirements.title: YouTube Account Home Recommendations & Subscriptions Feed
requirements.description: When signed in with Google/YouTube account, fetch InnerTube FEwhat_to_watch and FEsubscriptions endpoints in a single fast API call (<300ms) to provide genuine YouTube recommendations and watch history.
requirements.verification_criteria: Logged-in users see their personalized YouTube recommendations and watch history on the Home tab.

requirements.title: Feed Loading & Channel Scraping Performance Optimization
requirements.description: Strip redundant channelExtractor.fetchPage() calls from channel video extraction, use fast InnerTube FEsubscriptions single-call query (<300ms) for logged-in accounts, respect Room feed cache on startup (0ms cold start), and throttle concurrent local channel queries to prevent CPU/memory spikes.
requirements.verification_criteria: App cold starts in 0ms using Room cache; subscriptions feed loads in a single request (<300ms) when logged in; zero UI thread freezing or GC thrashing.

requirements.title: Playback Latency Reduction & Stream URL In-Memory Cache
requirements.description: Tune ExoPlayer DefaultLoadControl to start playback after 500ms of buffered audio instead of waiting for seconds. Implement in-memory StreamUrlCache with 2-hour TTL to deliver 0ms instant replay without redundant YouTube page extraction.
requirements.verification_criteria: Audio starts playing within 500ms; repeated track playback starts immediately (0ms extraction latency).

requirements.title: Automated Unit & Performance Test Suite with GitHub Actions CI
requirements.description: Comprehensive automated tests in app/src/test verifying feed JSON parsing, stream caching, hash generation, and stream selection performance. Configure GitHub Actions workflow to run gradle test with detailed logging and artifact reporting.
requirements.verification_criteria: Unit and benchmark tests execute successfully on GitHub Actions CI runner with published test report artifacts.
